result.summary: Found 1 major issue: untranslated or unreplaced section header displaying technical key instead of user-friendly text.

issues.description: Section header displays 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a translated or human-readable section name. This appears to be a localization/internationalization bug where the translation key is being shown directly to the user.
issues.suggestion: Replace the technical key with the appropriate translated text such as 'Popular near you', 'Popular restaurants', or similar depending on the app's localization system. Verify that all text keys are properly resolved to their translated values before rendering.
